$comment: Format reference for AGENTS.waivers.json (committed downstream; upstream ships none). A waiver turns an otherwise-FAIL relaxation of a core rule (secrets.*, refusal.*) into a WARN that is listed under Waivers on every `npm run audit`. Required: rule, reason, owner. Optional: expires (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, UTC; an expired waiver no longer counts) and layer (limit the waiver to one layer file). See docs/configuration-layers.md#compliance.

waivers.reason: Air-gapped lab without vault access; credentials come from the lab's sealed secret store, mounted read-only at runtime.
